verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS verification service and its SDKs and CLI, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The docs cover verification flows, results access, webhooks, review tools, MCP and CLI availability, and none of them mention telemetry controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
